title: [Incident Prevention] Live Lesson - Provider token refresh before starting from Calendar or BO
description: Prevent expired Salesforce/custom/provider token from blocking Teacher Web or Live Lesson entry.
preconditions:
- Staff user can open SF Calendar and BO Lesson Detail.
- Online lesson exists with valid teacher, students, teaching medium, and live lesson provider config.
- Test setup can simulate or prepare an expired/near-expired session token.
steps_actions:
1. Open the online lesson from SF Calendar and click Start Lesson.
2. Repeat the start action from BO Lesson Detail.
3. Keep session idle until token is near expiry, then start the lesson again.
4. Check logs/monitoring for the start action.
steps_result:
1. User is redirected to the live lesson room without INVALID_SESSION_ID, blank page, or infinite loading.
2. BO path also refreshes token and enters the same lesson room successfully.
3. Token is refreshed before use; no manual app restart is required.
4. Token refresh and room join are logged; failures are visible as alerts or searchable logs.
steps_data:
1. lesson = online
2. entry = BO
3. session = near_expiry
4. monitor = token_refresh
suite: Incident Prevention - Event Calendar Live Lesson Lesson-Learn

title: [Incident Prevention] Live Lesson - Reconnect and shared-session stability
description: Prevent join-state loss after network interruption browser refresh tab switch or shared device/session.
preconditions:
- Published online lesson exists with teacher and at least two students.
- Teacher and student can join from supported browser/device combinations.
steps_actions:
1. Teacher starts lesson and two students join.
2. Disconnect one student network for 30 seconds, reconnect, and rejoin.
3. Switch browser tab/app away and back during the lesson.
4. Log out one shared device account, log in as another teacher, and start a different online lesson.
steps_result:
1. All participants appear in the room; lesson remains active.
2. Student can rejoin without requiring lesson recreation; attendance/join state is not duplicated.
3. Audio/video/join state remains active or recovers automatically.
4. Teacher identity and lesson room are not reused from the previous session.
steps_data:
1. participants = teacher+2_students
2. network = temporary_disconnect
3. action = tab_switch
4. device = shared
suite: Incident Prevention - Event Calendar Live Lesson Lesson-Learn

title: [Incident Prevention] Live Lesson - Whiteboard poll pen and text latency guard
description: Prevent class-blocking latency or broken whiteboard actions during operational live lesson flow.
preconditions:
- Online lesson supports whiteboard/material sharing, poll, pen, text, undo, and redo.
- At least one teacher and five students can join the room.
steps_actions:
1. Teacher shares a PDF/material and moves between pages.
2. Teacher draws with pen, types text, and uses undo/redo.
3. Run a poll and close it.
4. Repeat on one lower-spec supported device and one desktop browser.
steps_result:
1. Page movement appears for students within acceptable latency; no blank/sunk page.
2. Each action is visible to students; undo/redo affects the teacher's own annotation correctly.
3. Student poll ribbon updates correctly; no stale poll remains after the teacher closes it.
4. Behavior stays within supported-device expectation; unsupported-device gaps are documented.
steps_data:
1. material = PDF
2. tools = pen,text,undo,redo
3. feature = poll
4. devices = desktop+tablet
